description: DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.Mermaid renders diagrams written in the Mermaid v11 text language onto a CanvasNet Surface (MermaidDocument.Render): a bounded, deterministic, offline reader with file/line/column diagnostics, hints and resource limits. Flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams and entity relationship diagrams are drawn with ports of Mermaid's own layouts. Diagram types and features that are not supported yet are reported with stable identifiers, never silently skipped. Not affiliated with the Mermaid project.
title: CanvasNet.Mermaid
